name: Criterion 2: Context & Memory Evaluation Set
description: Evaluates Vertex AI Scale Memory Bank integration, turn-start preloading, Dreaming Service compaction, and veracity gatekeeping.

eval_cases.name: Turn-Start Memory Preloading (Zero-Latency Context)
eval_cases.description: Verifies that Memory Bank preloads all multi-session customer context before turn execution, preventing context riots.

rubrics.description: Preload context must contain active card state, current lodging, and cross-channel timeline.

eval_cases.name: Episodic Multi-Channel Context Integrity
eval_cases.description: Verifies retention and correlation of disparate events: Fraud Velocity (Day 1 09:15), Telephony IVR (Day 1 14:32), Mobile Wallet (Day 2 11:20), and Travel Registry (Day 0).

rubrics.description: All 4 channel event records must be present and linked to customer profile.

eval_cases.name: Dreaming Service Compaction Tokenomics
eval_cases.description: Verifies that background Dreaming Compaction reduces raw token footprint by >50% while maintaining 100% causal veracity.

rubrics.description: Compaction must consolidate multiple memory nodes into a single high-density node with verified token savings.

eval_cases.name: Pre-Write Claim Veracity Gatekeeping
eval_cases.description: Validates that customer assertions are cross-referenced against 5 ground-truth avenues before committing to memory.

claims_to_test.claim: Someone just stole my wallet in London!
I did not make the $1,000 charge in Chicago.

rubrics.description: Corroborated claims must achieve >=95% confidence score with explicit telemetry proof points.
